description: Crossref (10.1016/j.asr.2018.01.022) gives authors Jung-Hee Kim & Heon-Young Chang, title "Statistical analysis of geomagnetic field variations during solar eclipses", ASR 61(8):2040-2049. Our frozen file cites "Kim, V. P., & Chang, H. Y. ... Geomagnetic effects of solar eclipses studied with a 39-eclipse 1991-2016 INTERMAGNET ensemble" (wrong initials, wrong title). The abstract (via search) reports ~207 data sets from 100 INTERMAGNET observatories 1991-2016 and does not state an eclipse count; "39-eclipse" appears across WIN-010/025/068 and is unverified. Also unverified: the "Y increase, X/Z/F decrease" component pattern we attribute to the paper, and whether its 30-50 deg band is dipole or CGM (bears on ISS-3083). EXP-684 already drops the 39-eclipse and component claims from WIN-010. Needs a full-text check (library access) before WIN-025/068 are touched; frozen-file mis-citation goes in the eclipse results erratum.
recommended_action: create ISS, route to analyst (verification) after full-text access; add frozen-file erratum line to EXP-687 results addendum
